name: What types of sliding glass doors are available for replacement?

mainEntity.name: What types of sliding glass doors are available for replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Several types of sliding glass doors are available, each offering distinct benefits. Popular options include vinyl doors, known for their affordability and energy efficiency; aluminum doors, prized for their strength and narrow frames; and wood or clad-wood doors, chosen for their aesthetic appeal and natural insulation. You can also select from various glass options, such as clear, privacy, low-emissivity (Low-E) for energy savings, and tempered glass for safety.
acceptedAnswer.description: Available types include vinyl, aluminum, and wood/clad-wood, with various glass options like Low-E or tempered.
